Provenance: scenario `bench/scenarios/run_calibration_verdict.R`, law test
`tests/testthat/test-scenario-calibration-verdict.R`, committed evidence under
`bench/scenarios/out/` (`cs11_arms.csv`, `cs11_lattice.csv`,
`cs11_precedence.csv`, `cs11_scalars.csv`, `cs11_degenerates.tsv`). TDD
record: RED watched (10 units, nb=87 failed=11 error=8 -- every red on the
absent runner or absent witnesses; the plant self-consistency and live
input-law units speak MEASURED laws and were green by design) -> GREEN
10 units / 248 expectations / 0 failures / 0 errors / 0 warnings; runner
OVERALL PASS (51 adjudications plus the pre-write witness-finiteness census);
double-run witness bytes `DET=IDENTICAL` (5/5 sha256 files, all non-empty,
behind the hard four-file count gate).

## 1. Mandate

Pillar 3's eleventh decision-record scenario. The scoping pass selected the
exported coverage-verdict face `ms_calibration_verdict()`
(`R/calibrate.R` -- the per-cell inclusivity lattice over the frozen
acceptance window `c(lo = 0.930, hi = 0.970)`, the ascending failing-cell
census, the all-in bit and the three-source window precedence) -- a face
whose unit suite speaks the machinery (the guard aborts, the shape of the
returned list) but never rendered the shipped decision -- the exact lattice
over planted fractions, the census order, the precedence ladder's two
flips -- as a decision record by any lane. Everything here is closed-form by
construction: the plant is hand-picked rational arithmetic, the executed
path touches no RNG and no network, and there is no seed to pin. The face
is called FRESH per arm; zero global state. The lane never invokes the
seeded grid/bootstrap estimators of the calibration module -- the declined
scope stays declined; the verdict face is the whole scope.

## 2. The plant and the six arms

The plant is `mean_coverage` tables whose values are exact rational source
labels (`0.935`, `0.930`, `0.929999`, ... -- the committed witnesses carry
the source TEXT, so the trailing zeros are law, not rendering), labelled
`cell1..n` -- D3 law: synthetic coverage fractions from hand-picked
rationals only, zero COSMIC numeric matrices, zero real calibration bytes,
zero downloads. The six arms, every one driven through the EXPORTED face
alone (the lattice bits, the census vectors and the all-in bits are the
face's own; no hand-rolled windowing is invoked anywhere in the lane):

- **all-in** -- three cells deep inside the frozen window: a full-TRUE
  lattice, the all-in bit lit, an empty census.
- **boundary-inclusive** -- cells EXACTLY at `0.930` and `0.970` flanked
  by `0.929999`/`0.970001`: the both-ends-inclusive law read from the
  live face, ends IN and epsilon flanks OUT.
- **flip-pair** -- one low failer `0.9299` and one high failer `0.9701`
  in one table: the ascending census `c(2, 4)` with per-cell bits.
- **precedence** -- one table, three band sources that DISAGREE: the
  explicit `window` argument outranks the recorded `window` attribute,
  which outranks the frozen default; both flips are MEASURED -- the attr
  rung condemns cell 2, the arg rung admits it again.
- **degenerates** -- an all-out table (the census names every cell,
  ascending), a single-cell table, the face's own shape laws (the lattice
  speaks UNNAMED, the window speaks NAMED `lo,hi`), and a committed
  `cs11_precedence.csv` ladder witness.
- **input-law set** -- nine probes (NA-bearing column, missing column,
  non-data.frame, zero rows, reversed window, non-finite window,
  length-1 window, character window -- plus the degenerate closed window):
  the eight guards ABORT with class `msuiter_error_input` and the two
  committed clauses verbatim; the ninth probe is an OBSERVED no-abort (see
  below).

## 3. The measured laws this scenario commits

- **The both-ends-inclusive boundary law.** `mean_coverage` equal to the
  frozen end reads IN -- at `0.930` and at `0.970` alike -- while the
  one-epsilon flanks read OUT. The witness commits the four bits and the
  two inclusivity pins; no off-by-one may ever enter this face silently.
- **The precedence ladder, both directions.** default -> attr flips the
  verdict (cell 2 condemned); attr -> arg flips it back (cell 2
  admitted). The committed `cs11_precedence.csv` carries the three rungs'
  window echoes verbatim.
- **The degenerate closed window is LEGAL.** `window = c(0.9, 0.9)` with
  `lo == hi` does NOT abort -- the guard's law is `lo <= hi`, an observed
  boundary of the input contract, committed as a witnessed no-abort
  rather than re-typed as a design claim.
- **The face's shape laws.** The per-cell lattice is unnamed; the window
  echo is named `lo,hi`; the census ascends in every arm; the all-in bit
  agrees with the census by construction, censused per arm.
- **Instrument failures caught fail-closed, twice again.** (i) The law's
  byte-exact label rail refused the first green (8 failures): this base's
  `read.csv` type-coerces look-alike-numeric columns, and the witness
  reader would have silently rendered `"0.930"` as `"0.93"` -- the
  committed rational SOURCE bytes are the law, so the readers now pin
  every column with `colClasses = "character"` (this base's `read.csv`
  predates `type.convert`) and the second green is the literal
  248/248. (ii) The same run exposed a law-side column-vs-scalar
  comparison in the all-bit expect, fixed with `rep_len` before commit.
  Both events are OBSERVATION-instrument failures caught by the project's
  own laws before any verdict was committed, never verdict failures.

## 4. Hard rails and postures

The hard rails: the per-arm committed lattice bits, census vectors and
all-in bits; the four boundary bits and the two inclusivity pins; the
three-rung precedence witness with its measured flips; the face's shape
laws; the eight input-law classes and the two verbatim clauses; the
witnessed no-abort of the degenerate closed window; the plant-checksum
dual-kernel identity (the canonical pure-R SHA-256 and the `digest`
accelerator agree on the plant's bytes -- the plant text is the rational
label string itself, so the checksum rides over source text, never a
float rendering); and the pre-write witness-finiteness census. Postures:
DECISION RECORD only -- no coverage claim, no calibration claim, no
threshold-fit claim; no bootstrap, no intervals, no conformal framing (the
declined words are spoken by the runner itself); the D11 float posture is
honored by construction -- the witnesses byte-freeze integer and label
verdicts and the exact rational source labels, and no ill-conditioned
float rendering is ever committed; the pillar-2 namespace-reach idiom is
banned in the law file and grepped away.
